title: should render both pricing cards with the Subscribed state and pricing options for a paid org
verifies: a pay-as-you-go Stripe org sees both cards, the Subscribed tag, and price-option tiles from mocked pricing.json

title: should show Subscribe for a free org and redirect to the hosted checkout URL
verifies: a free org shows Subscribe and clicking it redirects to the mocked hosted checkout URL

title: should show a retryable pricing error and recover on Retry
verifies: a blocked pricing.json shows the error in both cards and Retry re-fetches and repopulates

title: should render the Enterprise price block with exactly one On discount tag when priced
verifies: the Enterprise card shows a price block with a single On discount tag when pricing has a price

title: should replace the Pro buttons with the AWS Marketplace managed-billing message
verifies: an aws-billed org sees the AWS Marketplace tag and managed message instead of Subscribe/Manage

title: should replace the Pro buttons with the Azure Marketplace managed-billing message
verifies: an azure-billed org sees the Azure Marketplace tag and managed message instead of Subscribe/Manage

title: should replace the Pro buttons with the Contract managed-billing message
verifies: an external-contract org sees the Contract tag and managed message instead of Subscribe/Manage

title: should render the AI credits card with the per-feature breakdown
verifies: mocked ai/usage surfaces the AI credits card and the chat/incident/reanalysis breakdown

title: should show the managed-billing panel for a child org
verifies: a child org sees the managed-billing panel and View Organization Group button instead of the pricing cards

title: should show the On discount tag in the header only for the old-schema Enterprise card
verifies: old-schema pricing renders no Enterprise price block and one On discount header tag

title: should render the paid-AI-usage switch when the org is eligible
verifies: an eligible paid-overage status renders the paid-AI-usage toggle and hint
